 Rupee rallies to close 9p higher at 93.32 vs USD
 By: Agencies 
 Date:
 November 20, 2026 
 Share post:
 WhatsApp Facebook X ReddIt Telegram Linkedin 
 Mumbai, Nov 19: The rupee stayed firm for the fourth straight session and settled 9 paise higher at 93.32 against the US dollar on Thursday, backed by a softening greenback and foreign fund inflows amid massive buying in domestic equity markets.
At the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 93.40 and moved between a high of 93.17 and a low of 93.55 against the greenback. The unit ended the session at 93.32 against the dollar, up 9 paise from its previous close. (PTI)
